defaultPolicy: Only these four existing market IDs receive this global exact-food price gate. Generic terms and brands never supply missing qualifiers. Product-label evidence must be traceable to the specific offer; selecting a pantry entry or using the canonical group name is not proof. Strip only known leading brands; reject negated, conflicting, mixed or uncertain qualifiers. All per-store comparisons, direct recipe repricing, cached/saved recipe prices, shopping links and explorer scoring must use the same rule. Unqualified historical rows stay observed history, not verified current food-specific quotes. Group-level histories and benchmarks retain their original uncertainty; comparisons without exact food evidence must not claim qualified-identity savings. Unrelated market IDs keep their approved policies.

decisions.require: Original offer must name Hass and avocado, representing fresh unprepared fruit. Size, bag, generic avocado, place of origin or brand is not variety evidence.
decisions.reject: Reject generic large/medium/bagged avocados without Hass, named non-Hass varieties, mixed/unresolved food alternatives, frozen/canned/cooked/seasoned products, guacamole, avocado oil and prepared meals. Do not infer edible yield or source-derived retail weight.
decisions.scope: Apply to current market-board scoring and exact recipe/shopping price admission, before cheapest-per-store selection. Retain raw observations, historical assignments, canonical IDs/names/keywords, existing pantry availability and all source links. This is no source, alias, compatibility or inventory migration.

decisions.require: Original offer must identify chicken breast, boneless AND skinless, plus raw/uncooked/unprepared or cook-before-eating evidence. Chilled and frozen raw unprepared breast are the same reviewed identity; thaw frozen raw chicken in the refrigerator before these recipes.
decisions.reject: Fresh, a value pack, a brand, breast fillet wording, boneless alone or skinless alone does not prove every required qualifier. Reject bone-in, skin-on, thighs/tenders/cutlets claimed as breasts, cooked/deli/canned/breaded/stuffed/marinated/sauced products, unresolved cuts/species and conflicting state/form labels.

decisions.require: Original offer must identify fresh unprepared green cabbage. Whole or plainly cut/shredded raw green cabbage is the same food; retain the observed retail unit without a new yield conversion.
decisions.reject: Head, fresh or generic cabbage alone does not prove green. Reject red/purple/savoy/napa cabbage, bok choy, mixed slaw, kits/dressing, sauerkraut/kimchi and frozen/canned/cooked forms. A brand or color adjective attached to another food supplies no cabbage variety.

decisions.require: Original offer must explicitly identify fresh unprepared sweet potato or sweetpotato. A single label such as Garnet yams (sweet potatoes) can establish sweet potato only because it explicitly names it; a bare yam or Garnet-yam title cannot. No new yam alias or true-yam ingredient is proposed.
decisions.reject: Reject bare yams, Garnet yams without sweet-potato evidence, true yams/Dioscorea/ube, ordinary potatoes, mixed yam-and-sweet-potato offers, unresolved food alternatives, frozen/canned/cooked/mashed/fries/chips/pie/seasoned products. Retail terminology does not create source equivalence or a variety/flesh-color guarantee.
